newsitem.title: UK: Dlr shakes off weakness vs mark, yen in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Dlr shakes off weakness vs mark, yen in Europe.

text.p: The dollar recovered against the yen, rising back above 118 amid short-covering after fears U.S.-Japan trade tensions could resurface had pushed it lower overnight, traders said.

It also rose against the mark after an early blip below 1.83 marks but dealers said the U.S. unit lacked the momentum to move out of its one-yen and one-pfennig range. They expected the dollar to consolidate as the market had a listless feel and lacked direction after a volatile early part of the week.
"The dollar's basically range-trading across the board," said Bobby Jasper, trader at Fuji Bank in London.
